title: The Water-Source Where Error Wasn't Yet Certain

features.name: the forking waters
features.desc-on-touch: Here the stream has not yet committed. It flows in three directions at once, each path leading to a different version of what happened next, all of them equally real.

features.name: the griotic crossing
features.desc-on-touch: This is where the water learned to call and be answered. Each fork is a voice in a conversation about which version of the story took hold, which current carried history forward.

features.name: the map of all versions
features.desc-on-touch: Roads marked in dust and root show every path error could have taken, every way the story could have unfolded. They all radiate from this place. None of them are less true than the others.

features.name: the moment before certainty
features.desc-on-touch: You stand here and feel how soft everything is. The story has not hardened yet. Any voice could still change what current carries what version forward into the world.

features.name: the chorus of all possibilities
features.desc-on-touch: Different versions of this place all sing here together—traditions from everywhere the archive touches, telling the story differently each time, none of them losing force.

inscription: at the water-source, error had not yet learned to flow in only one direction; here all the stories run together without choosing
